exposure: radiological grade of respiratory distress syndrome
outcome: failure of INtubation-SURfactant-Extubation (INSURE) strategy (reintubation and mechanical ventilation within 72h)
cohort: The study participants were infants with a gestational age of <32 weeks who received the INtubation-SURfactant-Extubation (INSURE) strategy.
finding: Severe radiological grade, lower base excess (BE) levels at the first arterial blood gas analysis, and decreased use of antenatal steroids were independent risk factors for INSURE failure, and infants in the INSURE failure group also experienced higher mortality.
followup_time: 72 hours after birth for primary outcome
